authority_only_replacements.old:
The authoritative package metadata fixes \(G_{\mathrm{prim}}\) as the primitive member of CD6’s \(P/C2/C5\) partition. CD6 names that member \(P\), the “本原层,” and assigns
\[
h=1
\]
to \(P\), whereas the nonprimitive alternatives \(C2\) and \(C5\) have \(h>1\). Therefore the required source map is
\[
G_{\mathrm{prim}}\Longrightarrow P\Longrightarrow h=1.
\]
This inference uses the authoritative meaning of the label \(G_{\mathrm{prim}}\), not merely a coprimality condition such as \(\gcd(N,h)=1\).
authority_only_replacements.new:
The versioned semantic authority `SEM-G-PRIM-01`, verified against the GP3 source body and restricted to notation scope `G-positive-remainder-content-decomposition/GP3-v1`, states that the primitive unit/core is exactly the \(h=1\) content layer. The assumed label \(G_{\mathrm{prim}}\) is this primitive unit/core in that scope. Therefore
\[
G_{\mathrm{prim}}\Longrightarrow h=1.
\]
CD6 is used only for the resulting \(P/C2/C5\) content classification: \(P\) is the \(h=1\) layer, while \(C2\) and \(C5\) have \(h>1\). This inference uses the hash-pinned semantic definition, not package metadata or merely a coprimality condition such as \(\gcd(N,h)=1\).
